reason: A DSH orchestration plugin that routes top-level sessions to registered engines according to presets, supports pre-message switching, installs engine presets, and restores engine selection for continued sessions.

summaries.zh: 根据会话预设在 DeepSeek 与已注册的可插拔循环引擎之间路由 DSH 顶层会话，并管理引擎预设的安装与恢复。
summaries.en: Routes DSH top-level sessions between DeepSeek and registered pluggable loop engines according to presets, while managing preset installation and restoration.

capabilities: Routes top-level DSH sessions to registered loop engines based on presets
Allows engine selection changes before the first message in a session
Installs engine-provided presets into the DSH preset directory
Restores the engine associated with a preset when continuing a session
Passes per-engine configuration through to registered engines
